newsitem.title: GERMANY: Daimler to separate 1996 accounts out.
newsitem.headline: Daimler to separate 1996 accounts out.

text.p: Daimler Benz AG said on Wednesday it would split out its 1996 accounts to show profit, balance sheet and capital flow figures for its industrial and financial service activities.

Its Mercedes-Benz vehicle-making unit would also report separate profit figures for its passenger vehicle and commercial vehicle operations, Hans-Georg Bruns, head of the group's accounts, told a conference on shareholder value.
"We want to make it clear that on the one hand we are the most profitable passenger vehicle manufacturer in the world, but that our commercial vehicle side has problems," Bruns said.
Bruns added that the separation would show the different returns and capital levels associated with its industrial activities and those of its financial service activities such as leasing.
